label: Test the same existential giver across acquired powers and real comparative relations
summary: See docs/notes/actuality-esse-research.md §13. Matched wax restampings with independent and copied templates identify the relevance of surviving influence across erasure. Active seating distinguishes the patient’s exercised power from its susceptibility. On the founded reading, a producer can bring about a real relational fact by changing its other term. Aquinas In Physicorum V lect.3 nn.7–8 treats bilateral equality and the one-sided case of a column. The rod controls separate comparative contrast from intrinsic alteration, and equal additions at both ends from a change in their gap. A registered history route derives the original b26c10a0 from exact productive ancestry, target realization coverage and an openly interpreted path-credit premise. The ancestry conclusion can itself be derived from one effective source input or earlier covered contributor for each covered event by descent in stage. Possession of esse, preservation of a bearer, or a tag for a relational respect is insufficient to discharge those premises. The existing press application profile jointly satisfies the three sufficient inputs and has an actual non-esse target.
blocker: The examples establish reasons for a productive route in particular cases. Universal scope requires actual coverage for each eligible bearer and respect, and adequate event and cause interpretations for standing or relational perfections. Effective responsibility for a founded relational fact can reach one bearer via a change in another, without an efficient alteration of the fixed bearer. The reduction to integer contrasts, the histories tested and the earlier cause-at-esse composition do not settle this interpretation globally.

current_assessment.scope: Acquired qualities and founded comparative relations in the universal transfer argument, §13.
current_assessment.assessment: A named giver merits mediated credit where its productive input can be followed into the particular acquisition. For a real founded comparison the operative change can take place wholly at the other relatum. Neither mere retention of the bearer nor a true predication identifies that productive contribution. A ranked history with warranted realization coverage and a faithful path-to-cause interpretation is a sufficient conditional route to b26c10a0. Whether every relevant respect admits such attribution to the existential giver remains open.
current_assessment.next_test: Test standing determinations with no recorded new onset: does the named giver actively preserve their operative foundation, through a presently exercised sustaining power, or does the observed persistence rest on inherited arrangement in sustained bearers? Fix the temporal reading of CausesIn before importing historical credit.
current_assessment.supersedes: Answers the §12 acquired/relational next test for the selected histories and founded comparisons. The earlier assessment of Durand and Suárez, the general warrant for universal transfer, and the interpretation of unrestricted composition retain their scope.
current_assessment.evidence: Independent semantic challenge of §13, the source passages and five results at 288d59eaa61436c6f94d7e54ce447049f6c6a899. Targeted review accepted 45f329f3238a6fbfd5ae99f6fc3abe471b2c88b2 on research/acquired-and-relational-actuality. The revision distinguishes a qualifying realization for each eligible bearer and respect from attribution of repeated episodes, addresses the rival reading of subject-relative accidents and links the external cause-of-a-perfection definition. Universal coverage and the interpretation of credit for standing determinations remain open.
